official_sources.verification_note: Jordbruksverkets officiella GIS-sida listar årsvisa skifteslager 2015-2025 och blocklager inklusive 2015-2025, rekommenderar WFS/CQL och anger GeoPackage i SWEREF 99 TM. Grödkoder ska matchas mot rätt årsversion.

identity_matching.notes: Strict 1:1 uses min(F_C,F_H). Split/merge graph uses max(F_C,F_H). Thresholds are visible pilot baselines, not hidden crop/sliver thresholds.

history_status.pilot_basis: Frozen after STOPPUNKT C/D on Skurup 2015-2025: historical coverage below 1% is treated as no material public match because 1,189 of 2,223 former PARTIAL rows were below 1%, while the remaining PARTIAL distribution is concentrated toward substantial coverage. 1% is also the web-visible component threshold; it removes ~44% of grouped crop rows but only ~0.06% of field-year area. 5% secondary crop defines material mixture; >=95% coverage is complete. Raw components and raw overlap flags remain preserved.
